topic: Which beamforming strategies optimize power margins for heterogeneous PER users in feedback-free RLNC with joint throughput-PDR objectives?
consensus_response: To optimize power margins for heterogeneous PER users in feedback-free RLNC with joint throughput-PDR objectives, we can leverage rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) techniques to manage inter-beam interference. By allocating resources efficiently and adjusting the phase shifts of each antenna element, we can steer the main lobe towards the desired direction while minimizing side lobes that cause inter-beam interference. This approach enables efficient radiation pattern shaping and reduces the average used power, improving user satisfaction. Furthermore, integrating machine learning-based beamforming with existing precoding methods can further improve system performance by adapting to changing channel conditions and user demands.
reference_context: The reference context provides factual ground-truth on various beamforming strategies, including rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA), which is shown to manage inter-beam interference effectively. The context also highlights the importance of channel state information (CSI) quality in optimizing beamforming performance.
